notes: The paper is a primary article, not retracted (record is_retracted false; no retraction statement in the PDF), and does not state that its uptake values were published before. I1 is judged met because the paper reports its own TGA (gravimetric) uptake value for samples charged with H2 gas at 10 bar (4.98 wt% Ca/NH3-rGO; 3.99 wt% Ca/Asc-rGO), taken as the difference in weight loss between charged and uncharged samples on heating to 500 C under nitrogen. This is a weight difference across a temperature cycle, not an isothermal uptake (measurement_mode temperature_cycle, reference temperature 500 C if extracted). The TPD-MS (Fig. 9) gives no uptake value; the '2 wt% at 50 bars and 77 K' is quoted from other work [23,25]. I2 met: Ca-decorated rGO with XRF carbon 75-82 wt%. The decisive point is I3: pressure is 10 bar but temperature is given only as 'ambient temperature' (words); under the data dictionary a condition stated only in words is not a number and is not imputed (temperature_unstated), so I3 is judged not met and the first applicable code is no_conditions_stated. I4 is also not met (no surface area for any sample), so the paper is ineligible under either reading of I3; if a resolver accepts 'ambient temperature' as a stated temperature, I3 would be met and the code would be no_surface_area.
